== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|A parasite ring is a specialized artifact constructed from braided [[halfsilver]] and etched with intricate [[Script|script]]. It functions as a training tool for practitioners of the [[sacred arts|Sacred Arts]], acting similarly to weight training for the soul. While wearing the ring makes the process of [[cycling]] [[madra]] significantly more difficult and burdensome, it provides a greater reward by filtering the quality of the [[madra]]. This allows a user to build up [[pure madra]] and strengthen their spirit twice as fast, though the process requires more effort. Because it is used for spiritual cultivation rather than combat, the ring can actually hinder a user's physical control and movement during a fight. Such rings are rare items; one was noted in the possessions of a deceased traveler and held by a [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]], while others can potentially be commissioned from specific craftsmen.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The parasite ring is a braided [[halfsilver]] artifact etched with intricate [[Script|script]]. Held by the [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]], this ring functions by slowing the [[cycling]] process to make it more difficult for the user. Although it burdens [[cycling]], the ring results in twice the reward and assists in building up [[pure madra]]. [[Lindon]] eventually carries the artifact on his person, where it will ultimately help him overcome his deficiencies.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Originally stolen from the [[Heaven’s Glory School]], the parasite ring is an artifact that makes [[cycling]] twice as difficult while doubling the speed of spirit strengthening.
